You are the fix implementer for the final whole-branch review of PR-B "Easier navigation" of the ruflo-console Claude Code plugin. One fix wave covers all findings below.

## Where
Worktree C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-nav, branch feat/console-nav (HEAD 0fac41cdb), plugin dir plugins/ruflo-console. Windows 11, Node 24. vitest: from plugins/ruflo-console `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/<file>.spec.ts` (node_modules is a git-ignored junction — never commit it). Touch only plugins/ruflo-console. Do not push. Each commit ends with exactly `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>`. No new dependencies. Do not dispatch subagents. REQUIRED before each commit: `claude plugin validate plugins/ruflo-console` → "Validation passed".

## Findings (verbatim, abridged) and what to do
1. [Important] "The breadcrumb tells people to press a key that opens a different page. hooks/views/pane.ts:151-153: on every page except the agent page, the text says `· b <- <previous page>` whenever the trail has an entry. Under the B2 ruling there is no global Back key; outside the agent page `b` is the Hive-Mind key (Hive is in CORE_TABS), so someone on Claims who presses b lands on Hive-Mind." FIX: drop the `b <-` text on non-agent pages (the "◂ Back to X" button already names the page); keep "b goes back to …" on the agent page. Test in back-button.spec.ts: the blurb never contains `b <-` off the agent page; still says it on the agent page.
2. [Important] "The Terminal help guide still teaches keys the terminal does not have: hooks/help-topics-core.ts:218 'Tab to s stops, o opens a new one, z clears.' The Stop, New session and Clear buttons have no hotkeys." FIX: reword (e.g. "the Stop, New session and Clear buttons have no keys: click them"); extend the "terminal messages" scan in tests/key-labels.spec.ts to the help topics files (help-topics-core.ts, help-topics-more.ts) so it fails on the old line (RED first).
3. [Must-fix] "The Room" remains: hooks/help-topics-more.ts:91 button label 'Open The Room' → "Open the Room page" (or the canonical label "Room"); README.md:54 "menu: Safety → The Room" → use the current group name and page label (check NAV_GROUPS / VIEWS for the exact current names); hooks/ask-claude.ts:40 "Read The Room feed" → "Read the Room feed". Add "The Room" to the retired-name list in tests/group-scheme.spec.ts so it cannot return (careful: "the Room" with lowercase "the" in running prose is fine — decide the rule, e.g. match the capitalised "The Room" only, and say so).
4. [Extra] tests/group-scheme.spec.ts:79 retired-name regex is built in a plain template literal (`\w` becomes `w`) and its escape class is malformed — rebuild with String.raw and the escape helper from tests/key-labels.spec.ts; prove it still catches a planted case.
5. [Extra] hooks/commands.ts:115 `/ruflo dump` reads one word (`viewOf(second)`) — make it use the full rest of the line like `go`/`open` (`/ruflo dump learning lab` dumps Neural Lab). Test it.
6. [Extra] tests/refresh-instant.spec.ts header says "every page key" at narrow width but asserts digit keys only; make the header describe what is tested (digit keys, CORE_TABS pages, p/x/r/h).
7. [PR prep] ADR-478: add at the top of plugins/ruflo-console/CHANGELOG.md a `## 0.43.0 — 2026-10-10` section (copy the exact heading format/dash of the existing entries) with `feat:`/`fix:` bullets covering this branch: Back returns through the pages you visited (agents included) and a ◂ Back button in the breadcrumb; y/n always answer the confirm card; every "(key)" hint names the real key; one set of page groups and names across menu, tabs and help (Neural Lab, Claims, Plugins) with old names still accepted; /ruflo go <page> and finding pages by name in the palette and menu prompt; refresh no longer replays the boot screen (Settings → Replay boot); narrow panes keep their shortcuts. Bump the version 0.42.0 → 0.43.0 in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and everywhere else the console version lives (grep "0.42.0" in plugins/ruflo-console excluding CHANGELOG history; e.g. hooks/version.ts, scripts/smoke.sh).

## Process
TDD for 1–5 (RED then GREEN). Logical commits. At the end run: back-button, key-labels, group-scheme, commands-verbs, find-by-name, refresh-instant, history, key-shadow, nav*, help-docs, menu-* specs; report counts.

## Report (required)
Write C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\pr-b-final-fix-report.md: per finding: change, files, RED/GREEN; spec counts; validator output; concerns.
Then reply ONLY (<15 lines): Status, commits, one-line test summary, concerns, report path.
